validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: gem.wiki returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) all run, and wiki_citations.json has no entry for P4174, so the sheet's own cited sources could not be re-checked directly. Ran multiple targeted web searches (WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-task; fell back to WebFetch against duckduckgo.com/html, Bing, Wikipedia, SNGPL's own site, and OGRA). The exact string 'Mian Channu-Hasilpur Gas Pipeline' / 'Mian Channun - Hasilpur' returns literally ONE public result anywhere on the open web: the gem.wiki page itself. No independent news article, company page, or report names this specific segment. This is consistent with it being one of dozens of short SNGPL sub-trunk segments in this bulk-loaded 2023-07 batch that simply have no individual English-language (or, as far as I could search, Urdu) public coverage -- SNGPL's own published PDFs (Exit Points Transmission Aug-2025 declaration-of-capacity table, 2006 transmission system map) list only large industrial/SMS exit points and do not mention Hasilpur, Mian Channu, or Khanewal by name, so absence there is not informative either way. Wikipedia's Hasilpur article does not mention gas infrastructure. OGRA's site returned 403. HOWEVER: I cross-checked this row against the country's own registered reconciliation dataset (GulfPub / Petroleum Economist PE World Map, batches/pakistan-gas/staging/recon-gulfpub-20260807/match_diff.json), which is an independent commercial geodatabase, NOT derived from GEM. It contains a record (ref_id gulfpub:gas:9688, 'Mian Channun - Hasilpur') that the reconciliation engine matched to P4174 with composite 0.868 / 'green' confidence: name similarity 0.98, diameter exact match (12in vs GEM's 12), length 0.99 similarity (GulfPub geodesic 84.986km / stated length 85.295km [=53 miles, correctly converted post the 2026-07-29 gulfpub-gas miles-fix] vs GEM's 83.85km, a 1.7% difference well within slack given GEM's own RouteAccuracy on this row is 'very low (straight line/schematic)'), owner exact match ('Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd' both sides), and status exact match (both 'operating'). GulfPub's own pipe_type field is 'National' (its transmission-tier bucket, not 'Distribution'), supporting GEM's PipelineType=transmission. NOTE ON GulfPub's OWN DATA QUALITY: comparing real-world coordinates, GulfPub's start point labeled 'Mian Channun' (72.566034, 29.695563) actually sits at Hasilpur's true location, and its end point labeled 'Hasilpur' (72.311084, 30.415219) sits at Mian Channu's true location -- i.e. GulfPub's own endpoint labels for this record appear transposed relative to real geography (the same swap recurs one record over: GulfPub's 'Hasilpur-Haroonabad' record, oid 9689, gives Haroonabad the coordinate that is actually Hasilpur's true location). This does not affect the length corroboration (distance A-B = distance B-A) and does not undermine that a real ~85km, 12in SNGPL transmission line connects the Mian Channu and Hasilpur corridor -- but it does mean I cannot lean on GulfPub's raw start/end labels as confirmation of *which* GEM StartLocation/EndLocation field is correct, only that the segment and its length/diameter/owner/status are real and match. I therefore treat this as MEDIUM-tier corroboration (one strong independent source, not directly public-URL-citable) rather than a full pass with a citable [ref]. CLASSIFICATION: no concern -- consistent with GulfPub's own tier and with every other roster row's uniform 'transmission' classification for this class of SNGPL town-to-town segment. DUPLICATE: checked against the full 63-row Pakistan-gas roster -- no other row names Mian Channu, Hasilpur, or this corridor; the GulfPub record nearest in spec ('CC1 - Lala Musa', oid 7153, same 12in/53mi values) is geographically unrelated (Gujranwala-area coordinates ~73.17-73.98E/32.57-32.71N vs this row's ~72.3-72.6E/29.7-30.4N) -- coincidental shared round numbers in the underlying network table, not the same pipe. Flagging a related but out-of-scope lead for Discovery/Update, not for this row: GulfPub also carries a 'Hasilpur - Haroonabad' record (oid 9689, 8in, ~64km) that the reconciliation engine could only place as AMBIGUOUS between P4133 and P4174 (neither a clean match) -- this looks like a further downstream continuation segment SNGPL operates past Hasilpur that may not have its own GEM ProjectID; worth a Discovery pass, not an edit to P4174. ATTRIBUTION: StartLocation Mian Channu (Khanewal District, Punjab) and EndLocation Hasilpur (Punjab) are both real, correctly-provinced places; no attribution concern. SPEC: Diameter (12in) and Length (83.85km) both corroborated as above within normal tolerance -- no material disagreement, so no spec concern raised. Net: real pipeline, correctly classified, not a duplicate, attributes plausible and independently corroborated by a non-GEM commercial dataset -- but because no public webpage could be found that names this specific segment (and GulfPub itself is not a citable public URL, and its own source_url field is just the generic https://www.sngpl.com.pk/ homepage which would fail url_verifier's value-presence check), I am NOT proposing any [ref] URL for Status/Fuel/PipelineType/Length/Diameter/Location/Owner on this row -- flagging as confirmed-with-caveat rather than a clean pass.
